notes.title: Devlope Vlog Update&Share 1
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="XImR-xRpTXs;full"][/previewyoutube]
Hi everyone, long time no see!

I know many of you have been curious about our progress. As the producer, there’s a lot I’d love to share with you — so let’s treat this video as a casual dev vlog.

Over the past year, our team has been fully focused on technological upgrades and iteration.
As some of you may have seen, we recently launched the Nintendo Switch version of Arisen Force: LifeDevotee on the Nintendo eShop.

This title leverages our latest tech framework, allowing it to run close to 60 FPS on Switch — and for an action game, that smooth framerate is crucial to the player experience.
It’s something we’re incredibly proud of as a team.

We’ve also submitted version 1.0.2, which addresses some potential issues, and we expect the update to go live soon.

Now, let’s talk about Vonimir.

In our latest build, we’ve made significant improvements to character rendering and lighting systems, aiming for full cross-platform support and dynamic lighting effects.
We tackled the challenge of handling complex environment transitions, while still preserving the spatial freedom necessary for both combat and exploration.

We also built a range of in-house terrain tools, which dramatically improved the workflow efficiency for constructing the world of Vonimir — making level design much more flexible and efficient.

After releasing LifeDevotee and HeroTest, we realized that for a larger-scale project like Vonimir, continuous tech iteration, workflow optimization, and multi-platform testing are absolutely critical.
That’s why we dedicated this entire year to going back to the fundamentals and refining every layer of our pipeline.

Because our whole team has been focused on development, we haven’t had much time for community updates or video content.
But as LifeDevotee quietly made its debut on Switch, you could say — we prefer to speak through our work.

Currently, the PlayStation version is also in development.
Please continue to believe in us, and support us — thank you, truly, to every warrior of Vonimir!

In the next vlog, I plan to showcase some of the exploration skills, as well as how each weapon evolves — stay tuned!

notes.title: TGS Official BoardCast Indie Game Stream Link Release!
Fix Update 1.0.3, Combat Optimized . And Our Kickstarter surpassing 150% !!!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your support, our Kickstarter is surpassing 150%
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/e4b9fa7d6173de3ee40c136f20b26fcd53baae76.png

We appreciate your support and feedback. We have been working hard to improve the gaming experience, listening to your feedback, and addressing issues that may affect your enjoyment of the game.

Patch Highlights:

Features:

 Basic TalentSystem Revealed.
 Item System Revealed.
 Added the ability for players to freely control the direction while sprinting.
 Added the jumpcancel for normal attacks and skill at an appropriate time.
 Added German language support.
Added support for backpack scrolling with the right joystick.


Combat:

 Fixed an issue where knockback skills were sometimes ineffective.
 Fixed a bug related to the recall of summoned creatures.
 Optimized the performance of hit reactions.
 Optimized the position and displacement of damage numbers.
 Optimized the triggering of derived attacks.
 Optimized the aerial combo and juggling effects.
 Optimized the performance of aerial dashes.
 Optimized the attack speed of melee weapons.
 Optimized the resource consumption of some skills.
 Increased the flight speed of arrows.
 Optimized some skill hitbox.



Scenes:


 Added more rewards for destructible objects in the scene.
 Fixed scene performance issue after duel failure. 


UI:


 Fixed mouse interaction errors.
 Added save game guide.
 Optimized some UI icons.
 Optimized the loading of the world map.
 Added an opening animation for the world map.
 Added support for Inventory scrolling with the right joystick.


Systems:


 Character TalentSystem Unlocked.
 Implemented a diverse item system.
 Improved system stability.


Localization:


 Optimized the logic for selecting multiple languages.
 Optimized some translated texts.
 Added German language support.(please note that due to budget constraints, translation quality may be low, and we will strive to improve future localization quality).
 We hope these fixes and updates enhance your gaming experience. If you encounter any issues or have further suggestions, please feel free to contact us.


Thank you for your understanding and support.

Wishing you a joyful adventure in the Vonimir Land! Your support will make our content even better!

Check out our Kickstarter

[Youyuan][Gwendy]

notes.title: Fix Update 1.0.2 ,And Our Kickstarter Progress Almost 90% ！！
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you for your support, our Kickstarter is approaching 90%, and the exciting adventure in the Vonimir Land is just around the corner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43807037/114a2917d2dc144740bfb56570f7960f32f7d8bb.png
Kickstarter

We appreciate your support and feedback. We have been working hard to improve the gaming experience, listening to your feedback, and addressing issues that may affect your enjoyment of the game.

Patch Highlights:

Combat:


 Fixed an issue where knockback skills sometimes failed to knock back.
 Resolved an problem where the spider boss's projectiles would block the player's ranged flying projectiles.
 Added the ability to freely control the direction before initiating a regular attack.
 Optimized the attack speed of the giant sword.


Scenes:


 Fixed the issue of characters turning black in some situations.
 Optimized the world boss scene to reduce the likelihood of triggering exits.
 Improved the abnormal lighting of chests in caves.
 Added UI prompts for seal stones in forest scenes.


UI:


 Fixed mouse interaction errors.
 Fixed an issue where the save panel did not support scrolling.
 Optimized the mouse or keyboard Esc function for the shop panel and character details panel.
 Optimized the inability to return to the main page settings panel.
 Improved mouse or keyboard support for interaction and exploration pop-ups.
 Optimized some UI icons.
 Optimized the loading of the world map.
 Added an opening animation for the world map.


Systems:


 Added the option for key operation prompts to be displayed in the upper right corner of the screen during gameplay.
 Added UI display support for PlayStation controllers (currently recognized as Xbox controllers when launching from Steam; we will continue to research and fix this in future updates).
 Added support for mouse-click toggling in the pause menu.
 Added trial versions of the producer list and special thanks list on the main page.
 Improved system stability.


Localization:


 Added translation for the mage's magic slash skill.
 Streamlined some control descriptions.
 Added support for Korean (please note that due to budget constraints, translation quality may be low, and we will strive to improve future localization quality).
 We hope these fixes and updates enhance your gaming experience. If you encounter any issues or have further suggestions, please feel free to contact us.


Thank you for your understanding and support.

Wishing you a joyful adventure in the Vonimir Land! Your support will make our content even better!

Check out our Kickstarter

[Youyuan][Gwendy]
